question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'pull in'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• From the options it is clear that the given blank will have a phrasal verb of pull.
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given phrasal verbs - ​
 
 
• pull of - This is incorrect. the correct phrasal verb is **pull off ** which means to succeed in doing something that is difficult.
 
• pull through - get through an illness or other dangerous or difficult situation.
 
• pull in - attract
 
• pull out - (of a vehicle) move out from the side of the road, or from its normal position in order to overtake.
 
 
 
• The given line with the blank talks about how oxygen is attracted to our lungs by alveoli. 
 
• Thus, from the above meanings it is clear that pull in is the most appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - Oxygen fuels our living processes. It contracts our muscles, helps our cells to work, grow and regenerate, (1) feeds our brains, calms our nerves, helps the heart to pump, fights infection and (2) boosts immunity," says Dr Narendra Nath Jena, Director, Institute of Emergency Medicine, MMH R Centre, Madurai. Once air enters the nose or mouth, it gets humidified and reaches (3)** the **alveoli. The alveoli are tiny air sacs that help to (4)** pull in **oxygen and transfer it into the blood stream and also to pull out the carbon dioxide and push it out of the lungs. COVID-19 destroys (5) **these **alveoli by thickening the walls so gas exchange becomes difficult.*
